label_metadata.positive_label: actual delivery calendar date > estimated delivery calendar date
label_metadata.stage3_difference: Stage 3 compares full delivery timestamps against estimated-date midnight; Stage 4 compares calendar dates, so delivery during the estimated day is on time.
label_metadata.maturity_purge: Training labels must be available strictly before validation_start; validation labels must be available strictly before evaluation_start.

policies.purpose: development comparison; not a new independent final test
policies.preprocessing: fit exclusively on each purged training fold; no train+validation refit
policies.validation: prediction_time in [validation_start, validation_end), labels available strictly before evaluation_start
policies.maturity_wait: Default folds leave one whole calendar month after validation for labels to mature
policies.evaluation: fixed monthly prediction intervals; completed outcomes scored retrospectively with no label-maturity purge
policies.original_test_protection: No original fixed-test prediction orders, metrics or saved predictions are used or modified
policies.late_labels: Some historical evaluation orders are delivered on/after the original test start; only prediction dates are bounded
policies.threshold: six learned models maximize validation F1; Dummy remains at 0.5 as the most-frequent reference
policies.ranking: unweighted mean evaluation AP across all three successful folds; population std (ddof=0)
policies.score: positive-class predict_proba values are uncalibrated delay scores
policies.threading: threadpoolctl limit covers fit/predict; ensembles receive n_jobs explicitly
policies.model_promotion: No model artifact, original metrics.json or original test predictions are updated

limitations: The cohort contains eligible completed deliveries only; cancelled/unfinished orders are not represented.
Label-maturity purging preferentially excludes long deliveries and positives; before/after counts quantify this selection bias.
A one-month maturation wait reduces but does not eliminate validation bias or threshold uncertainty.
Evaluation prevalence differs by month, so AP and threshold metrics vary with the cohort.
Three development months and their standard deviations are not confidence intervals or guarantees of future performance.
Training is frozen before validation; waiting-period orders do not update the fold model.
The original Stage 4 fixed test was already evaluated; this script does not reuse it for development ranking.
